scope: Native create/start lost acknowledgement and owner interruption diagnostic orchestration
observations: Injection requires retained actual successful daemon response and a durably released matching creator phase, rather than any exception.
Started worker must be running with open stdin and no input-delivery intent before the owner interruption.
Completion requires canonical ownership fence, independently complete reconciliation and a repaired daemon epoch.
Final transport join and evidence publication failures retain the original orchestration error and do not skip reconciliation or permit a pass.
limits: This narrow source review does not replace native daemon confinement, benchmark measurements, the complete accounting audit or contract approval.
